cohort_summary: 10 anytime-HR longshot hunters (4 pro desktop-heavy, 6 amateur, 4 on phone). The 1+ HR board's transparent math (per-PA rate x slot xPA, lineup ✓, rest-of-game HR% with PA left) earned genuine praise, but the cohort's value loop breaks at the same spots: no book price/implied/fair American odds so every prob must be converted and line-shopped by hand; the HR-specific inputs they bet on (park HR factor, weather/wind relative to field, barrel/EV, pitcher HR/9 and pitch mix, platoon handedness) are absent from Predictions — park/wind only exist in the collapsed game pill (blank here) and hand filters only on Data Feed's historical view. Calibration in the 10-30% longshot band is too coarse, phone record strip shows Hit even on HR, and there's no lineup-posted alert or bet/CLV logging. 3 failed (weather pro, pitch-mix pro, platoon amateur); the other 7 partial; avg NPS 5.2.
